_what: Every saved TradingView probe checked against its committed source, WITHOUT adding any study to any chart. 2026-09-10 evening.
_how: GET pine-facade/get/<id>/last gives the stored source; GET pine-facade/translate/<id>/last gives {IL, ilTemplate, metaInfo} and metaInfo.plots is the VENDOR'S OWN plot roster. Both are ordinary authenticated reads of the owner's own scripts. The stored source's sha256 was computed in the page; the committed side was normalised and hashed locally, and the roster was derived by a balanced-paren scan of the committed file.
_why_this_matters: ⭐⭐ THIS IS THE H6 GATE WITHOUT A CHART. Until tonight, checking that a saved probe still matches its committed source meant putting the study on a chart and reading its metaInfo -- which needs the add mechanism that is currently broken (see docs/pine/capture-procedure.md). The translate endpoint answers the SHAPE question on its own. ⛔ It does NOT answer the VALUES question: a roster is what the script would plot, not what it plotted. Captures still need the study on a chart.
_three_number_gotcha: ⚠️ DISK BYTES, CHARACTERS AND STORED CHARACTERS ARE THREE DIFFERENT NUMBERS and confusing them makes every comparison fail. These probes are full of multi-byte marks, so groupb-hilo-default.pine is 3810 bytes, 3502 characters, and 3557 characters once the vendor's CRLF line endings are applied. Compare CHARACTERS, and allow the trailing newline to be absent -- UCTPROBE_FOLD is the one stored without it.
_the_deliberate_failure: ⭐ UCTPROBE_GB_BARSSINCE_2ARG IS SUPPOSED TO FAIL AND ITS ROW PROVES THE GATE CAN SEE FAILURE. Its source declares 3 plots; translate answers success:false with a ONE-plot stub. That is the same failed-study signature the chart shows, read here without a chart -- and it independently corroborates the CE10115 arity reading that divergences.json::barssince-unbounded-vs-bounded-state rests on. A sweep where every row passes for the same reason would be a sweep that cannot discriminate.
